title: What is the difference between ViewBag, ViewData, and TempData in ASP.NET Core?
description: Understand the different ways to pass data in ASP.NET Core MVC.

data.text: **Question:** What is the difference between ViewBag, ViewData, and TempData in ASP.NET Core?
ViewBag and ViewData pass data from controller to view for the current request. TempData uses session state to pass data across requests, typically for redirect scenarios.

**ViewBag:**
- Dynamic property (uses C# dynamic keyword)
- No casting required
- Life: current request only
- Uses ViewDataDictionary internally
- Example: ViewBag.Message = "Hello"

**ViewData:**
- Dictionary object (string keys, object values)
- Requires casting when reading
- Life: current request only
- Example: ViewData["Message"] = "Hello"; string msg = (string)ViewData["Message"];

**TempData:**
- Dictionary stored in session state
- Life: survives one redirect
- Uses TempDataDictionary
- Requires session state middleware
- Example: TempData["Message"] = "Hello"; persists after RedirectToAction
